content: Next.js 16 breaking changes: (1) Async Request APIs — cookies(), headers(), params, searchParams, draftMode() are now fully async in v16; synchronous compatibility layer from v15 is removed. Route handlers must await params: const { team } = await params. (2) middleware.ts deprecated for Node runtime; replaced by proxy.ts. Edge runtime support gone. (3) revalidateTag() now requires second argument (cacheLife profile). (4) images.domains config removed; use image.remotePatterns. (5) AMP APIs removed. (6) next lint command removed. (7) Node 18 dropped; minimum is 20.9. Empty parallel-route slots now require default.js files.
